title: Nepali Psalm 23 Multi-Tier Hanging Wall Plaque
description: A beautiful 5-panel hanging wall art piece featuring the complete biblical text of Psalm 23 (भजनसंग्रह २३) in elegant Nepali script. The panels are crafted with classic corner border accents and linked together by durable metal chains for easy wall mounting. It serves as a meaningful, faith-inspired decorative piece for home living spaces, prayer rooms, or as a thoughtful religious gift.

title: Rustic Nepali Psalm 23 Multi-Tier Hanging Wall Art
description: Bring a touch of faith and serenity into your home with this beautifully crafted multi-tiered hanging wall decor. Featuring the complete and beloved biblical scripture of Psalm 23 (भजनसंग्रह २३) written in elegant Nepali script, this piece serves as a meaningful daily reminder of spiritual guidance, comfort, and protection.

title: First Loved Boho Macramé Hanging
description:
Bring warmth, serenity, and faith into your space with this artisan-crafted boho wall hanging. It features an engraved round wooden plaque with the inspiring message of 1 John 4:19 in Nepali script, framed by delicate botanical motifs. Beneath it flows intricate, layered macramé in soft sage green and natural cream cords, highlighted by a central twist and a smooth wooden accent bead. 

A graceful, faith-filled statement piece for any room or a thoughtful gift for loved ones.

title: You Are So Loved Macrame
description:
Bring warmth and heartfelt charm to any space with this handmade macrame wall hanging.

A natural wood semi-circle plaque is engraved with the sweet message “you are so loved” in elegant cursive script. Soft mustard-yellow cotton cords cascade below in a beautiful knotted pattern, finished with long flowing fringe that adds texture and movement.

Perfect for bedrooms, nurseries, living rooms, or as a thoughtful gift, this boho-inspired piece creates a cozy, loving atmosphere wherever it’s hung. Easy to display with the included white hanging cord.

title: God’s First Love Macrame
description:
A heartfelt handmade Christian wall hanging featuring a beautifully engraved wooden plaque with the powerful Nepali scripture from 1 John 4:19 (“We love because He first loved us”), crowned with a cross rising over the mountains. 

Below the plaque, soft mustard-golden cotton macrame flows in classic knotted patterns and long fringe, creating a warm, earthy, and spiritual presence.

Perfect for homes, prayer corners, churches, or as a meaningful gift of faith. This piece combines authentic Nepali Christian heritage with natural handmade craftsmanship, bringing both beauty and the message of God’s love into any space.

Key Features:
* Engraved wooden plaque with original Nepali Bible verse (1 John 4:19)
* Mustard-golden cotton macrame with traditional knots and fringe
* Cross and mountain design symbolizing faith
* Natural wood bead hanging loop
* Ideal for Christian homes, prayer rooms, or gifting

title: Inspirational Wooden Macrame Hanging
description: This cute, handmade ornament combines a natural wooden plate with a soft cotton macrame fringe. Each version comes in a different shape—like a circle, arch, or rectangle—and features a beautifully engraved message or scripture verse in English or Nepali. It includes a simple top loop, making it easy to hang as a lovely daily reminder in your car, bedroom, or any small space around the house.

title: Laser-Engraved Bookmark
description: Custom engraved MDF bookmark — perfect for personalised text, quotes, or verses.

title: Haven Macramé Cross Hanging
description: Handcrafted from natural cream cotton cord and mounted on a smooth wooden dowel, this boho macramé tapestry features an intricately knotted central cross surrounded by elegant linear cords and a textured fringe finish. A serene, faith-inspired statement piece that brings warmth, peace, and timeless texture to any wall.
